messages:
alex: Heads-up — planned maintenance for az3 Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling node reboots + BGP soft-flip. Expect ~15% GPU capacity reduction for up to 30m windows per cohort. Will stagger across racks to avoid a single-region drop.
jen: Who needs customer comms? Any tenants on dedicated pools that require pre-notice?
ryan: Noted. Dedicated pools get separate notice by SRE. This affects hosted and interruptible capacity primarily. We'll try to avoid impacting reserved capacity but chore may touch some bumped machines.
sam: Can we move start to 03:00 so EU peak isn't affected? EU shows higher churn between 01:30-03:30 UTC for a couple of tenants.
alex: We can shift cohorts — plan is to do low-traffic racks first (rack ids: r-az3-02..05). Start at 03:00 for those racks instead of 02:00. Overall window still 02:00-06:00 UTC to give us slack.
paul: Ops question — any BGP flapping risk during the soft-flip? Last time we saw transient 1–2s route withdrawals that triggered TA timeouts.
maria: We'll use incremental next-hop swap + hold timers (180s). Network's set to graceful withdraw. I'll push the change and monitor for AS-PATH flaps.
ops-bot: maintenance-schedule created: id=ms-2026-az3-0827, start=2026-08-27T03:00:00Z, owner=@alex (link: https://redwood.internal/maint/ms-2026-az3-0827)
ryan: Evac plan: drain pods with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` then wait for KV cache to reseed. We'll preseed kvcache on warm standby nodes using job `kvcache-seed --target=r-az3-standby --ttl=2h`.
jen: Any backfill plan for interrupted jobs? Spot backfill or pause/resume semantics? Cost approval needed if we blast extra spot capacity.
alex: Use spot backfill up to 20% of baseline, capped at $3k total for the window (pre-approved). If more capacity needed, escalate to @paul for cost sign-off.
sam: Also watch latency SLOs for short tail — last maintenance saw 10% p95 increase for 5m after warmup. Can we seed prefix cache on adjacent pools first?
maria: Yes — we'll run prefix-seed to warm the common prefixes: `prefix-seed --regions=az3,az2 --ids=common-1001` before starting reboots.
paul: Rollout order proposal: cohort A (low-priority interruptible), wait 20m, cohort B (mixed), wait 30m, cohort C (reserved last). If any smoke fails, auto-rollback to previous BGP config.
alex: Ops runbook link in thread: https://runbooks.internal/az3-rolling-reboot. Key checks: K8S drain success, KV-seed coverage >=95%, p95 latency delta <5% for 10m.
jen: Can SRE team send a short customer notice for hosted customers? "Planned maintenance might cause brief capacity shifts; no action required." I'll draft.
ops-bot: runbook-checklist: k8s-drain, kvcache-seed, prefix-seed, bgp-grace, alert-watchers-added.
ryan: Adding temporary alert thresholds: token generation errors >0.5% for 5m OR p99 latency >2s => abort.
maria: I'll keep BGP hold timers conservative and monitor MRT logs. If we see AS path churn >3, abort.
paul: Tagging cost center: ENG-INFRA-MAINT-0827. Use that for chargebacks.
jen: Draft notice posted to #customer-notify for review. Please add any hard constraints (reserved customer lists) by EOD.
sam: I'll coordinate with support on sticky sessions and ensure sticky cache keys are re-bound.
alex: Thx. Final plan will be in the maint ticket. Quick checklist for tomorrow: preseed at +30m, commence cohort A at 03:00, pause and validate, then continue. React with :thumbsup: if you ack.
maria: :thumbsup:
paul: :thumbsup:
ryan: ack — will be on-call.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance ms-2026-az3-0827 assigned to alex, reminder 60m before start.
